flags.note: Orange 'answer' cells use different shades (51% and 57% dark, 28% light) for the same meaning, and the 'flooded' row has no orange cell though it also has a job.
The chosen/rejected bar chart is empty at step 0, and its caption is cut off ('nothing trained yet. Pre'). A newcomer can't tell what the axis shows before pressing Train.
'TTL' is used in the technical analogy and the evidence with no definition.
'tensor parallelism' is named only in passing and 'tensor cores' appears earlier in S15, neither explained.
On the left chart the y-axis '0' label collides with the orange dot at batch 1, and the right-hand 27 ms ceiling is unexplained.

visuals.S01: Recap diagram: text tokens 'The river bank' flow through 32 blocks, then logits→softmax, then sample, then append and run again; a KV cache row per token sits below.
visuals.S02: Recap with two multiple-choice guesses (weights source; decode tick ~0.02 ms/~21 ms/~2 s), no chart.
visuals.S03: Four token boxes 'The river bank flooded' with a slider; a table lists examples 1-3 as prefix → next token (orange = the answer to guess).
visuals.S04: Loss curve −ln p against probability (0.01→4.61, 0.5→0.69, 0.9→0.11) with an orange dot at 0.20; bars show the five word probabilities (20% each) and gradient bars (blue ↑0.80 for flooded, red ↓0.20 for the others).
visuals.S05: 4×4 attention grid with Mask off/on toggle; cell shade = attention percent, orange cells = the answer sitting just right of the diagonal (cheating); with the mask on, cells above the diagonal go blank.
visuals.S06: Model-size tabs and sliders for tokens and GPUs; a grid of teal squares (each = 256 H100s), an orange bar of 67.7 days against a 1-year bar, and a table comparing training with serving.
visuals.S07: Toggle between base and chat model, and between 'what you typed' and 'what the model reads'; orange text = generated continuation (more questions for the base model), teal = special chat-template tokens.
visuals.S08: Token strip with a bar under each token showing its loss; prompt and template tokens show ×0 in answer-only mode and answer tokens have teal bars; the counted loss is 1.06 over 8 of 16 tokens.
visuals.S09: Chosen (blue) and rejected (red) answer cards, a divergence bar chart of change in log-probability (empty at 0.00), and an RLHF/DPO toggle with a pipeline: preference pairs → pair loss → update model.
visuals.S10: Timeline bar: a short teal TTFT block (283 ms) then blue decode ticks (21.1 ms each), with end-to-end 8.70 s and 47 tokens/s stat cards.
visuals.S11: Two line charts against users in the batch: total tokens/s rising in a concave curve to 11,991 and TPOT per user rising linearly to 27 ms; a pink region = KV doesn't fit; an orange dot marks the current batch.
visuals.S12: Prefill bar (1,500 tokens in 24.3 ms) against a long blue decode bar (500 ticks, 2.42 s); stat cards give 16.2 µs per input token, 4.84 ms per output token and a 299.6× ratio.
visuals.S13: A full teal bar for one GPU-hour ($3), with cards for $4.04 per 1M tokens and 743,097 tokens per GPU-hour; teal = time spent decoding.
visuals.S14: Five request rows of 8 prefix blocks (solid teal 'write' on request 1, dashed 'read' on requests 2-5) plus an orange 'new' block; TTFT is 145 ms then 20.9 ms; cards show 2,250 tokens computed and a $0.0107 bill.
visuals.S15: Two GPU memory columns (80 GB each) filled grey by 70 GB of weights, with a thin teal tile for each request's cache under a dashed 92% cap line; precision tabs; cards give 140 GB, 21.0 ms, 10 requests and 460 tokens/s.
visuals.S16: Lab controls (model, GPUs, precision, batch, tokens), a memory bar per GPU with a 92% cap, and result cards: TTFT 141.5 ms, TPOT 21.8 ms, 367 tokens/s, $4.54 per 1M output tokens, with the formulas written out.
